h1: Custom Hanes Koozies for Your Brand
metaDescription: Order custom Hanes koozies for your next event. Perfect for branding with your logo. Bulk pricing available at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Hanes koozies combine the trusted comfort of Hanes apparel with the practicality of a koozie. Whether you're outfitting a company picnic or a trade show, these koozies offer a soft, absorbent surface ideal for screen printing or embroidery. Choose from classic styles that keep drinks cold and your brand visible.
heroAltText: Custom Hanes koozies with embroidered logo, keeping a cold drink insulated
